industry: MRI simulation and radiology training software
summary: Företag 11 develops MRI simulation software for radiology education, MRI operator training and protocol optimization. Its cloud-based platform enables realistic MRI training without requiring access to physical MRI scanners.
target_market: Global medical imaging education and radiology training market
strategy_notes: Focused on scaling MRI education through software-based simulation and expanding internationally across healthcare training and workforce development markets.
technology_notes: Uses cloud-based MRI simulation technology that replicates scanner physics, imaging workflows and protocol settings in a virtual training environment.
risk_notes: Dependent on healthcare training budgets, adoption by educational institutions, international expansion success and competition from established medical imaging vendors.
